[kanbot/EV0XEBCZ-4-show-how-many-todos-are-left-in-the-head 18ae824] Show count of not-done todos in the page heading
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

input.summary: Followed the plan exactly in commit 18ae824. In public/index.html the h1 now has id="heading". Right after render() fetches the list, it sets the heading to `Todos (N left)`, where N counts the todos with done false. render() already runs on page load, after the add form submits and after a checkbox changes, so the heading updates in all three cases without a reload. With no todos, or all of them done, N is 0. node --test passes (6/6). I did not do the manual browser check. The heading reads plain "Todos" until the first fetch finishes, which the plan accepts. EV0XEBCZ-2 also edits render() in public/index.html, so a small merge conflict there is possible.

criteriaResults.note: The heading is set from todos.filter(t => !t.done).length when the page first loads.
onsubmit calls render(), which updates the heading.
box.onchange calls render() after the PATCH.
An empty list, or one with every todo done, gives a count of 0, so the heading reads Todos (0 left).

crossTicketRisks.description: Both tickets edit render() in public/index.html, so a small merge conflict is possible there.

payload.text:
The page heading now shows how many todos are left, for example `Todos (3 left)`. It updates when you add a todo or tick or untick one, without a page reload. `node --test` passes, but I didn't open the page in a browser to check it by hand.

The change is two lines in `public/index.html`, following the plan. The heading gets an id, and `render()` sets its text from the number of todos not marked done. `render()` already runs on page load, after adding a todo and after ticking one, so that covers every case. With no todos, or all of them done, it reads `Todos (0 left)`. It's committed as 18ae824 and I've reported the result.

- **Before the first load:** the heading reads plain `Todos` until the list loads, which the plan accepts.
- **Merge conflict:** the due-date ticket (EV0XEBCZ-2) also edits `render()` in `public/index.html`, so a small merge conflict there is possible.
